title: Enterprise Admin Access Intake & Prioritization Framework
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a clear, repeatable intake and prioritization process for enterprise admin & access feature requests (SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, RBAC, org-level policies, audit/retention). Goal: reduce decision latency for PM and Engineering, align trade-offs with Security and Sales, and produce a triage outcome (Immediate / Near-term / Backlog) with suggested scope and resourcing.
background: Over the last 6 months we have received ~40 distinct admin/access asks from trial and enterprise accounts. Requests range from one-off SSO integrations to multi-tenant RBAC models and org policy enforcement. Sales and AE teams escalate requests frequently; engineering lacks a consistent set of signals to estimate effort. This creates misaligned expectations and slow response for customers with compliance needs.
triage_rubric: Security & compliance risk (0-5): Is this required for regulatory compliance (SOC2, HIPAA, FINRA)?
Customer revenue / strategic value (0-5): Does the requesting account represent >$X ARR or strategic expansion?
Uptime/SLA necessity (0-3): Is this required to meet a contractual SLA?
Workaround availability (0-3): Can customers operate with current APIs or manual processes?
Engineering scope estimate (T-shirt): S / M / L with example tasks
Cross-team dependencies (0-3): Requires Security, Legal, Billing, or infra changes?
Operational cost / long-term support (0-3): Will this increase console/ops maintenance burden?
sample_requests: Okta SAML + SCIM user provisioning with SCIM delta support and group sync for multi-team orgs (customer: FinSolutions; asks for automated onboarding + deprovisioning).
Granular RBAC: nested org roles (Org Admin, Billing Admin, DevOps Reader, Model Deployer) and role inheritance rules for >5k-seat customers (customer: RetailCo pilot).
Org-level model allowlist/denylist policy: prevent hosted models with external data access for regulated pipelines; apply per-environment. (customer: HealthTech).
Audit log retention control and export API: configurable 1/3/7 year retention for enterprise legal requests.
prioritization_result: Recommended outcome: Implement a lightweight intake page + rubric onboarding (Phase 1) to provide standardized decisions and SLAs for common asks. Phase 2: scoped delivery of high-impact features (SAML+SCIM baseline, basic RBAC role templates). Phase 3: advanced RBAC and retention/archival workflows. Mapping: Immediate=Phase1 (intake + quick wins), Near-term=Phase2, Backlog=Phase3.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form deployed in the Console with required fields (customer tier, compliance needs, requested features, urgency, contacts)
Triage rubric implemented as a scoring helper visible to PM and Solutions Engineering
A documented decision pattern with expected SLAs (7 business days for Quick Response, 30 days for Scoped Delivery) published to Sales/AE playbook
Top two high-impact requests (SAML baseline + SCIM provisioning MVP) scoped and triaged into ENG backlog with estimates
next_steps: 02/23: Ship intake form wireframe and fields matrix; gather feedback from 3 AEs and 2 Customer Success leads
02/27: Run rubric calibration workshop with Eng leads (Runtime, Identity) and Security — capture edge cases (nested orgs, delegated billing)
03/05: Publish intake + rubric to internal Confluence + AE playbook; start collecting production requests
03/10: Triage first 10 incoming items using rubric; create ENG tickets for top two scopes and assign owners
decision_log: 2026-02-21: Kickoff aligned — PM, Eng Identity, Security present. Agreed to prioritize a repeatable intake before building features.
2026-02-27: Engineering requested tighter scoping for SCIM MVP (limit to users + groups first; defer delta optimization).
2026-03-03: Sales asked for explicit SLA communication; PM proposed two-tier SLA (Quick Response vs Scoped Delivery).
2026-03-10: Finalized Phase 1 scope: intake page + rubric + SAML baseline docs. Phase 2 scoping to begin after initial metrics from intake.
notes: Trade-offs discussed: heavy-weight RBAC model increases maintenance and UX complexity; recommend role templates + custom roles later.
Consider offering 'Compliance Pack' paid add-on (SAML+SCIM+7yr audit export) for immediate revenue capture — review with Pricing team.
Metric to track: time from incoming request to triage decision; target median <= 5 business days after rollout of intake form.
